i. Rain: Rain is an important source of water in Pakistan. Only a small part of it receives rainfall
in excess of 1000 mm. This includes: Murree, Hazara and Swat etc. Upper Indus plain, Astore,
Chitral, Bannu, Peshawar, Zhob and Quetta etc., receive rainfal in range of 250 to 1000 mm,
whereas the rest of Pakistan receives less than 250 mm of rain annually.
